eyebrow: Dizziness That Hits Only When You Move Your Head

items.name: Lying down too long makes it worse
Headache plus double vision is an emergency

closing.headline: Brief spinning triggered by a specific head movement is worth suspecting as BPPV.
closing.tip: The Epley maneuver at a doctor's office often brings major improvement in one or two sessions.
closing.cta: Severe headache or slurred speech means the ER; otherwise get checked by an ENT specialist.
